description: NAVSUP WSS Mechanicsburg is soliciting for the intended sole source repair of QTY 10 each, NSN 7HH 5998 012647608, Circuit Card Assemblies. This item is on Basic Ordering Agreement N0010424GCN01. Reference attached solicitation. The Navy does not own the drawings. Any interested parties can submit a SAR package in order to become eligible repair source for future opportunities.
